power_domains_summary.VDD_HVR: 2.7-3.6 V (typical 3.3 V) main supply for SDSC / SDHC / SDXC at standard speed and UHS-I startup.
power_domains_summary.VDDIO_UHS_I: 1.8 V signaling rail; same as VDD in single-rail designs.
power_domains_summary.VDD_LVR: 1.65-1.95 V (typical 1.8 V) supply for UHS-I after CMD11 voltage switch and for low-voltage cards (LVR bit set in OCR).
power_domains_summary.VSS_VSS2: Two ground pins; VSS2 typically used as the dedicated CLK/DAT return.

power_up_sequence: 1. Host applies VDD ramp (≤ 250 ms ramp time).
2. Host waits ≥ 1 ms after VDD reaches operating range.
3. Host drives ≥ 74 dummy CLK cycles with CMD HIGH.
4. Host issues CMD0 (GO_IDLE_STATE) — card enters Idle state.
5. Host enters CMD8 / ACMD41 initialization loop with VDD window.

low_power_modes_summary.Clock_Stop: Host may stop CLK between transactions in Default / High Speed / UHS-I modes; not allowed in UHS-II.
low_power_modes_summary.Power_Off: Host de-asserts VDD — full state loss. After re-power, host must redo full init.
low_power_modes_summary.FXE_Power_Off_Notify: Function Extension Power Management Register Set provides Power Off Notification, Power Sustenance, Power Down Mode — see Section 5.8.1.
low_power_modes_summary.Sleep: Not formally specified for SD Memory Card; eMMC defines a SLEEP / AWAKE state via CMD5.

header_columns: Maximum Current (mA at 3.3 V or 1.8 V)

fxe_power_management_register_set.Power_Off_Notification: Card supports graceful flush before VDD removal via dedicated FXE register sequence.
fxe_power_management_register_set.Power_Sustenance: Card maintains its internal state (e.g. cache) across a short VDD interruption when the bit is set.
fxe_power_management_register_set.Power_Down_Mode: Card enters lowest internal power state while maintaining ability to wake on bus activity.

fields.notes: Section 6.4 (Power Scheme) is normative: power-up sequence for SD bus interface (6.4.1) and for UHS-II interface (6.4.2). Power consumption is bounded per bus speed mode (Section 4.16.2.2 for Application Performance Class and Section 4.13.4 for Video Speed Class).
